# Feature: Mobile Branding

## Overview
Implement a mobile branding system that ensures consistent brand experience across mobile apps and responsive interfaces for both staff and customers.

## User Stories

1. Mobile App Branding
   - As a business owner
   - I want to brand our mobile app
   - So it matches our company identity

2. Responsive Elements
   - As a brand manager
   - I want brand elements to adapt to mobile
   - So they look good on all screen sizes

3. App Icon Customization
   - As a business owner
   - I want to customize app icons
   - So our app is recognizable

4. Splash Screen Design
   - As a brand manager
   - I want to customize splash screens
   - So app loading reflects our brand

5. Mobile Navigation
   - As a UX designer
   - I want to brand mobile navigation
   - So the app experience is consistent

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create mobile theme system
- [ ] Implement responsive asset handling
- [ ] Build icon generator
- [ ] Create splash screen builder
- [ ] Implement navigation theming
- [ ] Add preview system
- [ ] Create asset optimization
- [ ] Implement version control
- [ ] Add usage analytics
- [ ] Create backup system

## Acceptance Criteria
- Mobile theme applies properly
- Assets scale appropriately
- Icons generate correctly
- Splash screens work properly
- Navigation themes consistently
- Preview shows accurately
- Optimization improves performance
- Analytics track usage

## Technical Notes
- Use mobile-first design
- Implement proper asset sizing
- Use background jobs for processing
- Cache mobile assets
- Follow mobile UI guidelines
- Implement proper logging

## Estimate
- Story Points: 8
- Time Estimate: 1 week

## Dependencies
- Brand Assets feature
- Portal Customization feature
